p.s: INVENTIONS HAVE AFFECTED ALL OUR LIVES!
The invention without no doubt, that has affected my own life by far is the car.
Cars have definitely changed all our lives, and I am not refering only in a positive way, but in a negative way as well.
Picture this: a big city such as London or New York with no cars on their streets.
Could you imagine it?
To be honest, I can't.
Cars are part of our daily lives.
Traffic jams make people nervous, sometimes really upset and violent.
But, anyway, people use cars.
If we don't use them we suffer from them.
In my case I use public transport during the week to go to work but I could hardly imagine my weekends without my beloved car.
I really need it to escape from the pollution, mainly caused by cars and any other four-wheel motored vehicle.
Isn't that contradictorious?
To go to the countryside and being able to breath fresh, non-polluted air, I use my car, which, as far as I am concerned does not help to maintain a clean air at all.
Therefore

I am thinking in selling my car, which has changed my life over the last 10 years, which has given me a kind of freedom, which has gone with me to all sort of fantastic places, and change my life for a new life: whithout car.
